verdict.rationale: Asana provides mechanisms for context-preserving handoff: an API/webhooks, app components embedded in tasks, a documented MCP server for agent access, and AI Teammates described as having 'shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph' plus explicit tutorials on reading status updates and sharing them in another tool. This shows first-party support for moving work/context between Asana and other tools/agents, but there's no independent or hands-on verification that context/information is preserved without loss in practice. Missing for 10: independent case studies or hands-on tests confirming lossless context transfer, technical detail on how shared memory/context persists across agent handoffs, and evidence of real-world multi-tool agent workflows succeeding end-to-end.
